messages:
alex: heads-up — planned maintenance tonight 21:00-22:00 UTC to run a coordinated NIC handshake and soft reboot on ember-11 and ember-12 (eu-west1). we'll do rolling node drains, short reboots, and a KV cache reseed after each node.

priya: ok. what's the expected GPU capacity hit and schedule per rack?

alex: estimate peak ~7% GPU capacity reduction for ~25-35m while warmbackfill runs. schedule: ember-11 stream starts 21:00, ember-12 stream starts 21:20. we'll never reboot two hosts in the same hostgroup concurrently.

tom: suggested cadence: cordon -> evict-batch-jobs -> soft-reboot -> nvlink-check -> kv reseed (90s) -> uncordon. 6m gap between nodes. run two streams but AZ-safe.

lea: can I own canaries and rollback? want an alert if error-rate OR p95 latency > 1.8x baseline for 8m.

alex: yes — lea owns canaries. ops-bot: create incident stub and set paging to oncall-sre if thresholds exceeded.

ops-bot: Incident stub created: INC-20240615-1799990001. Paging policy: oncall-eng -> oncall-sre on page trigger.

priya: tenant comms? Dedicated customers might see queuing. no billing changes but recommend notifying top SLA tenants.

tom: fallback plan — scheduler will prefer capacity from the ember-reserve pool and throttle new long-seq requests to these racks for 45m after maintenance. performance might degrade but no billing impact.

alex: runbook at /runbooks/infra/ember-nic-handshake.md. checklist after each node: `systool -v -n nvidia`, `journalctl -u kubelet -n200`, `nvlink-health --quick`, `nvtop -b -t 30`, and a 2-min perf probe: `curl -sS http://perf-canary.local/ping?sleep=30`.

lea: I'll post short status updates every 7m here. will trigger rollback if canary fails twice in a row.

priya: ops note: queue-scheduler flag `gradual_backoff=45m` added to route table at start time; ops-bot please apply tag `maintenance=1799990001` to ember racks.

ops-bot: Tag queued: `tag-rack ember-11 ember-12 maintenance=1799990001` — will execute at window start.

tom: small optimization: increase kv reseed parallelism x1.4 during warmbackfill to reduce cold-cache tails.

alex: agreed. starting at 21:00 UTC. will paste a short postmortem link in this thread after the window. thanks all. :thumbsup:
